mapper.sql: SELECT U.USER_ID, U.USER_NM, U.USER_ENPSWD, U.USER_SE_CD, U.OGDP_BZENTY_NM, U.DEPT_NM, U.MBL_TELNO, U.TELNO, U.EML_ADDR, U.USER_STTS_CD, U.PSWD_EXPRY_YMD, U.LAST_LGN_DT, U.LGN_FAIL_NOCS, U.USE_YN, U.REG_DT, U.MDFCN_DT, U.AUTHRT_CD, A.AUTHRT_NM FROM user_info U LEFT JOIN authrt_info A ON A.AUTHRT_CD = U.AUTHRT_CD AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_info WHERE USER_ID = #{_parameter}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_info (USER_ID, USER_NM, USER_ENPSWD, AUTHRT_CD, USER_SE_CD, OGDP_BZENTY_NM, DEPT_NM, MBL_TELNO, TELNO, EML_ADDR, USER_STTS_CD, PSWD_EXPRY_YMD, LGN_FAIL_NOCS, USE_YN, RGTR_ID) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userNm}, #{userEnpswd}, #{authrtCd}, #{userSeCd}, #{ogdpBzentyNm}, #{deptNm}, #{mobileNo}, #{telno}, #{emlAddr}, #{userSttsCd}, DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY), 0, #{useYn}, #{rgtrId})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_info SET USER_NM = #{userNm}, AUTHRT_CD = #{authrtCd}, USER_SE_CD = #{userSeCd}, OGDP_BZENTY_NM = #{ogdpBzentyNm}, DEPT_NM = #{deptNm}, MBL_TELNO = #{mobileNo}, TELNO = #{telno}, EML_ADDR = #{emlAddr}, USER_STTS_CD = #{userSttsCd}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, MDFCN_DT = NOW(), MDFR_ID = #{mdfrId} WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND USE_YN != 'N'
UPDATE user_info SET USER_ENPSWD = #{userEnpswd}, PSWD_EXPRY_YMD = DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY), MDFCN_DT = NOW(), MDFR_ID = #{mdfrId} WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND USE_YN != 'N'
UPDATE user_info SET AUTHRT_CD = NULL, USE_YN = 'N', USER_STTS_CD = 'DELETED', MDFCN_DT = NOW(), MDFR_ID = #{mdfrId} WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND USE_YN != 'N'
UPDATE user_info SET USER_STTS_CD = 'NORMAL', LGN_FAIL_NOCS = 0, MDFCN_DT = NOW(), MDFR_ID = #{mdfrId} WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND USER_STTS_CD = 'LOCKED'
UPDATE user_info SET LGN_FAIL_NOCS = LGN_FAIL_NOCS + 1, USER_STTS_CD = CASE WHEN LGN_FAIL_NOCS + 1 >= 5 THEN 'LOCKED' ELSE USER_STTS_CD END WHERE USER_ID = #{_parameter}
UPDATE user_info SET LGN_FAIL_NOCS = 0, LAST_LGN_DT = NOW() WHERE USER_ID = #{_parameter}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cntn_log (USER_ID, LGN_IP_ADDR, CNTN_BGNG_DT, CNTN_BRWSR_NM, CNTN_YN, FAIL_RSN) VALUES (#{userId}, #{loginIp}, NOW(), #{browserNm}, #{loginSuccessYn}, #{failRsn})
mapper.update: UPDATE cntn_log SET LGT_DT = NOW() WHERE USER_ID = #{_parameter} AND CNTN_YN = 'Y' AND LGT_DT IS NULL ORDER BY CNTN_BGNG_DT DESC LIMIT 1
